full_judgment:
21. Mr. Bhuiyan lastly submits that the trial court correctly decreed the suit on merit upon proper assessment of the pleadings, evidence and other Materials on record, but the court of appeal below misread and mis-appreciated the evidence and materials on record and came to an erroneous decision since as the final court of fact, did not apply its judicial mind and independently assess the evidence and other materials on record in violation of its mandatory obligation under Order 41 Rule 31 and 33 of the Code of Civil Procedure, rather turned down the decision of the trial court on some perverse, unfounded and untenable findings without assigning any reason and also without reversing the findings of the trial court and as, such the impugned judgment and decree being not a proper judgment of reversal, is illegal and liable to be set aside, and in support of his submission Mr. Bhuiyan has placed reliance on the decisions reported in XII ADC 751; 14 BLD 229; 17 BLD 47; 10MLR 255; 15 BLD 96. 

 41. On perusal of the pleadings, evidence and other materials on record, I am of the considered view that the judgment of the trial court is very much sound, proper and in accordance with law for, the reasons stated above and it does not suffer from any misreading or non-reading of evidence or non-consideration or misconstruction of any document affecting the merit of the suit and as such I. find no reason to interfere with the same. On the other hand, the court of appeal below misread and mis-appreciated the evidence and materials on record and came to an erroneous decision by failing to apply its judicial mind to the given set of facts and failed to independently assess the evidence and other materials on record in violation of its mandatory obligation under Order 41 Rule 31 and 33 of the Code of Civil Procedure, and turned down to the decision of the trial court on some perverse, unfounded and untenable findings without assigning any reason and also without reversing the findings of the trial court and as such the impugned judgment and decree being not a proper judgment of reversal, is illegal and liable to be set aside.
